items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: admired Braud Hat Brow and I thought he was a marvelous base player

ctx.x: No, that's okay. I just wanted it on the record, so they knew who that was.

Panama, you talked about drumming and when you started drumming -- were there any drummers that you heard that inspired you to want to be a drummer? I know in my case, I used to hear Duke's band come through and admired Braud Hat Brow and I thought he was a marvelous base player and I wanted to be like him. But was there anybody, any drummers that you looked up to?

Well, there was a guy in Miami, his last name was Abrista, but one night a couple of guys got in a fight, and he was from the Bahamas and he was telling the guys to let him go, but instead of saying let him go, he said, "lette go", and he got this nickname, "Lettego", and everybody used to call him Lettego and so he and my cousin Harold who was a trumpet player, and he used to play all the house parties around Miami.
